summary: Honor declared work waits before sending idle-holder nudges

replay.detail: Reads the existing folded work wait deadline; no replay changes.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: A future work wait --for deadline holds the idle-holder nudge. Renewing the wait extends the hold. At expiry the existing step deadline wake re-evaluates normal nudge eligibility.

compatibility.detail: Existing work wait claims and operator hold views are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback restores previous nudge behavior.
